sourcesNote: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags: the official list on Exophase, cross-checked against PSNProfiles. Progress counts are PSN's tracked targets. Guides are written in our own words for this entry.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task: work the six roadmap stages in order and this is the last one to unlock.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: it pops when you finish the Gone Fishing mission early in the story. Just play through the opening missions and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that does not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 2. This is also when switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, which unlocks the partner trophies and most of the open-world activities.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 3. Watch for the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand during this chapter — it carries an hourglass icon and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 4. The robbery tools for the late-game trophies arrive here — bank vaults open through an optional mission near the end of this chapter — so play the optional missions too.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: One of only two gold trophies: finish the final story mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it — after the credits everything outside the story stays open, and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission trophy: complete Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. No special preparation is needed — it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission trophy: complete The Cartel Heist when it comes up in the story. It pops on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission trophy: complete Child's Play when it comes up in the story. It pops on completion.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission trophy: complete Headliners when it comes up in the story. It pops on completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission trophy: complete VCIA Takedown when it comes up in the story. It pops on completion.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission trophy: complete Operation Savage Glory when it comes up in the story. It pops on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The second gold trophy and the hardest one: reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which only appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but work done earlier still counts. The checklist wants, among other things, 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models and all 8 bank vaults, so keep playing past each trophy's own target instead of stopping at it.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 stunts in total to find. Flying under bridges is the quickest kind to repeat. Note that 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one race, one fishing trip, one arcade game, one shooting-range challenge and so on through the list. It fills in naturally while chasing the other activity trophies; check the in-game activity list for any type you have not touched yet.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the ranges. Treat it as the list's main skill test: learn each challenge's par time or score, use a weapon you control well, and retry single challenges until they turn gold. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not every race at each one, so move on as soon as a location is ticked off and come back later for the rest.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Mix street races, drone races and any other race type; each distinct event you win counts once, and the counter is visible on the trophy's progress.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types, so the trip also counts toward Master of None. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to completion. Arcade machines are found around Leonida — pick the game you find easiest and finish one full run. It also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands stay open after the story, so there is no rush — but Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which tracks other strands.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the credits.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which tracks other strands — check that trophy's counter after each strand you finish.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones counted, and do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. It stays available after the credits, like the other side-story finales.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which tracks other strands.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Play Bret Vogel's hunting questline — a Jason-only strand that sends you after animals through target decks — and hunt the unique animal it asks for. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt grades on.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect them as you explore and track which sets are still missing cards. The sets are a long hunt, so fold card-hunting into your exploration for The Goodtime State rather than doing it as a separate sweep.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK works like a camera check-in: open the app at a named place and log it. Fold it into your exploration — every new place you visit for The Goodtime State is a chance to WAiNK it too. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges listed under Progress > Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play — driving, shooting, exploring and robbing all feed them. Note that 100% completion needs 70, so keep going past 50 rather than stopping here.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted level, then lose the police and escape the heat zone together. Bank vault jobs hand you a 4-star Wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns this. The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — keep moving fast between shops and do not let the Wanted level drop. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of only counting cars you have driven. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle to drop five of them before Focus runs out. Adrenaline extends Focus, and range time raises your Focus level.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so keep going past five.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Tail a truck until it stops, break in, take the cash and get clear of the heat zone — the trophy pops once you have escaped, not when you grab the money. Bank vault jobs (see Maximum Withdrawal) teach the same escape rhythm.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 places of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map — the counter tracks places, not map percentage, so check the map for regions you have never set foot in. Fold in the WAiNK check-ins (You WAiNKer!) and card hunting (Don't Touch My Deck) on the same trips.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida — hit a different gang's operation each time and check the counter. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way to that.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. It is a small hidden one-off — no mission, no counter, just the right place and a drink. Do it whenever you are passing Ocean Beach and it pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through the front of a vehicle showroom and smash your way out the other side, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build up speed on the approach and drive straight through. It pops on the smash, not on the escape.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Get Jason and Lucia both to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. It should pop when both characters hit the max together — train regularly rather than leaving it to the end.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — by the time you have finished the robbery and gang trophies you will be most of the way there. Check the profile counter if you want to see how far along you are.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: A hidden one-off whose exact trigger is still being pinned down on launch week — guides list it among the small hidden feats that pop from an ordinary repeated action. Try the things you do twice in a row in free roam and it should unlock in normal play; check the community guides linked in our sources section for the confirmed trigger as it is verified.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A hidden one-off tied to a strange scripted moment in free roam — the kind of trophy that pops when something unexpected happens to you out in Leonida. Keep playing the open world and it should find you; the community guides in our sources section are tracking the confirmed trigger on launch week.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down bowling pins with a melee drive-by — drive past a set of pins (or bowlers) at speed and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle to send them flying. Line the car up with the pins first, then swing as you pass; a slow pass will not do it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — sell them on to your contacts to wash them. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering every batch you earn instead of spending the bills as-is.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, car mods — so it fills up in normal play. If you are close at the end, the eight garages for Little Boxes are a fast way to finish it off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count — only the eight you buy. Each garage also gives you somewhere to store cars you register for On the Spot, so buy garages before registering cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
